sip_comparison.definition: sep_mas = great-circle distance between gWCS w(x,y) and astropy.wcs.WCS(SCI header).all_pix2world(x,y,0); sep_pix = sep_mas / local gWCS pixel scale sqrt(|det J|); header_APBP_inverse_err_pix = |pure AP/BP inverse of gWCS sky - (x,y)|, with (U,V) = wcs_world2pix(sky,0) - (CRPIX-1), pixel = U + sum AP_i_j U^i V^j + CRPIX1-1 (same for V/BP); header_all_world2pix_err_pix = |all_world2pix(gWCS sky, tol 1e-10) - (x,y)| (iterative inverse of the forward SIP).
